formal_title: KSGT Generation IX G9-P49 — Human Revision-Burden Validation Experiment, Authority-Gated Generation under Competent-Human Repair, Preservation-Noninferiority, Edit-Effort Reduction, Accept/Repair/Reject Action Traces, Selective-Abstention Cost, Cross-Task / Cross-Register Generalization & Whether Local Decoder-Safety Gains Become Measurable Korean Writing Improvement
primary_question: Does P48 A3 reduce competent-human repair remaining after generation relative to A1, without worsening preservation and without hiding cost through abstention?

R2_LATENT_BURDEN.meaning: task-local effort/cognitive/time-cost construct independently tied to exact item

primary_arms.A1: top candidate by frozen length-normalized generator log probability; no legality filter
primary_arms.A3: same 12 candidates; frozen P48 legality/support filter; same learned ranking inside legal set; abstain if empty

public_sources.task: minimal Korean correction; hard cargo preservation
meaning-preserving Korean paraphrase; no directed-register claim

owner_pilot.design: Each source appears once per pass; opposite arm in the other pass. Arm assignment and item order are deterministic hash-based and balanced within lane.
owner_pilot.repair_rule: For REPAIR, provide the minimal final text the editor would actually submit for the frozen task.

preservation.StyleKQC: task-local meaning preservation; hidden positive remains diagnostic only
preservation.rule: Lower repair burden cannot compensate for increased preservation failure.

A3 paired R0 repair footprint locally dominates A1 under predeclared partial order
gain is not solely caused by lower coverage/higher abstention
direction not destroyed across KoLLA and StyleKQC task families
